text: I'm not a musician and I've never been a rap fan before I met Chanyeol because in my opinion he is the absolute exception from all rappers in the entire K-POP industry. Chanyeol has such a deep diverse voice that it is easy to adjust to the mood and feelings of any song.

author: @liza_pet
text:
I can't describe how much I love the voice and vocals of Chanyeol and this is the main rapper 
of the group that's what the KINGS OF VOCALS OF ALL K-POP means. Chanyeol has a great command of his voice and I really like how it 
can be from incredibly gentle and deep to rude and audacious. Always after listening leaving utter admiration THAT'S WHAT A TALENTED PERSON MEANS–TALENTED IN EVERYTHING.

author: @liza_pet
text: Do Kyungsoo is just incredible in every sense. He is one of the few vocalists who can make your heart flutter and cause a storm of emotions. He manages his deep voice and sweet timbre with such ease that the same part can sound completely different "starting very roughly and ending unrealistically gently". Kyungsoo's unique voice gives each song a unique charm. I'm ready to listen to his voice as much as I want.! Even when Kyungsoo just speaks, he wants to listen and listen to endlessly, such a pleasant voice.

author: @liza_pet
text:
Baby Kyungsoo is the cutest, polite, and humble idol in the entire K-POP industry. Although he does not consider himself cute and does not 
like to be called that, but it's the truth and he 
has absolutely nothing to do to be so cute. 
I love him madly for such spontaneity, sincerity and absolutely unique vocals that you can listen to endlessly.

author: @liza_pet
text:
Once again, I am convinced that EXO is the biggest diamond, not only in the entire history 
of sm, but in the entire history of the K-POP industry. It's been 11 years, but I haven't seen 
a better band, especially with regard to vocals.

author: @liza_pet
text: EXO is a diamond not only of SM but of the entire K-POP industry. I sincerely apologize, but the visual effects of EXO are too powerful, as soon as they appear on the stage, they capture you with their dazzle, not letting you go until the very end. It's been a whole 11 years, but they simply have no equal in live performances.

My own opinion:

First, Popularity and achievements are from their fans. You streamed their songs multiple times, watched their mvs and buy their albums. Meanwhile, we don't care about any of that. Yes, we do care about our faves achievements and we do try to make them win by voting but not to the point that we're going to waste our time watching the same my for an hour or so. They don't force us too. They remind us that we have a life aside from them.

Second, recognition is also based on popularity. My faves get recognised because of their talents. Their vocals, their sense of style, their versatile acting, their dance styles. They have a life beside shitloads of comebacks and our faves can stand alone without the help of their members. For example: EXO Baekhyun could be BYUN BAEKHYUN as a soloist, as an actor, a luxury brand ambassador.

And I'm proud to say that this is what EXO taught us. We didn't have so many views in an my bcs they always remind us that we should focus on ourselves first or study first than watching their ig lives, them who always tell us to buy foods instead of alburns, and most especially having their own unique talent in their solo activities with us making us all proud as EXO-LS

author: @camilafranco847
text:
That was the concept of EXO in their early debut days, this is the version of EXO-K (Korean) the members that were part (Suho, Baekhyun, Chanyeol, D.O, Kai, Sehun) EXO-M The other six (Xiumin, Kris, Luhan, Lay, Chen, Tao) sing and have their own mv in the Chinese version EXO-M

Although in some videos like Growl, Overdose, etc, the twelve sang, this format was kept until 2015, after the departure of Kris, Luhan, and Tao, EXO-M is inactive.

EXO never released separate versions of their songs again, the 9 members participate in the songs unless for reasons of military service or as Lay (who is pursuing his career in China) has not been part of certain record materials.
Sorry to make it long but I wanted to explain it well :(

text:
Exol olarak 9. yılıma girerken her şeyin başladığı yere gelmenin daha özel olacağını düşündüm :")
Nereden başlasam, neler söylesem cidden bilemiyorum nadiren rastlanılacak durumdayım şaun aşırı duygusal bir sakura olarak yazıyorum bunları :"""
Öncelikle her bir üyeme minnettarlığımı dile getirmek istiyorum sizlerden çok güzel şeyler öğrendim ve bunları hala uygulamaya çalışıyorum aslında habersizce bir insan da yetiştirdiniz belki de benim gibi bir çok kişinin hayatına dokunup güzel izler bıraktınız ✿
Sizlerle tanıştığımda gerçekten çok küçüktüm aklımca kendime ait bir dünya oluşturmuştum kafamda ve oraya yalnızca siz girebildiniz. O küçük dünyama ışık olduğunuz için teşekkür ederim Exo'm sizi oraya soktuğum için hiçbir zaman pişman olmadım. Bir kez bile of ben ne yaptım böyle diye düşünmedim. Evet çok ciddi şeyler yaşadık, hala da yaşıyoruz.. iftiralar, haksızlıklar bana en ağır geleni ve aylarca atlatamadığım  üye ayrıkları.. Ama biz her zaman bir olduk. birbirimize güç, dayanak olduk birbirimize sımsıkı sarılıp WE ARE ONE EXO SARANGHAJA diye haykırdık.. Şuanki yaşadıklarımız için de yine aynı tepkiyi veriyoruz.
Exo-L olmanın gerçekten bir ayrıcalık olduğunu düşünüyorum. Bizim öyle üyelerimiz var ki aerisinin gözlerinin içine bakarken kalbi titrer, gözleri parıldar.
Ben Baek'in kızı, Xiu'nun kelebeği, Kai'nin araba motoru, Chen'in meleği... Exo'mun Aeri'si olduğum için kendimi dünyanın en şanslı insanı gibi hissediyorum.. 90 yaşıma gelsem de bu değişmeyecek her zaman.. nefes alıp verdiğim süre boyunca sizlerle olmaktan asla ama asla vazgeçmeyeceğim 12 gölgeli 9 adam ♡♡♡

text: Istg, if I was a kpop fan at this time, exo would've been my favorite group and the group that got me into kpop (I'm an ult army). I can actually understand the fan wars now, although they are stupid, exo has been around longer and compare the debut tracks, exo takes the cake. They would've did so well in america because this is what we were on at the time, MVs and songs that looked and sounded like this. Definitely more my style. Someone asked me (since I became an army July 2018) if I would've stanned bts in their debut era and I thought abt it and said no. No More Dream was cute and I'm not throwing them under the bus to uplift exo I'm saying based on my personality and who I was listening to at the time, it would've been a fat hell no. Even now, I'd show someone exo videos to get them into kpop because in my opinion, they are more fit for the american artists. The goody love yourself message can only last so long in america before people go back to violence, hate, and partying. If only someone drew their cards right, exo would've been the biggest kpop band rn and that's facts. Music wise I can't choose one over the other because I love them equally tbh, but I catch myself always feeling in the mood for an exo bside. I really understand it. They really are on the same level, both super groups, different style of music, equally large fanbase, fame, and achievements. Its like you really can't choose. Dunno where this comment went, I'm just saying I finally see the frustration y'all had on the way things turned out. But bts also went through a lot and deserve their fame they really make good music. I think exo-ls and armys would've been great friends and powerful allies if y'all didn't say and do dumb ish to each other because at the end of the day its just music and abt the music. text:

We All Should Know smth about streaming on YouTube :
 Each click on the mv link befor 300th views will be count as a view 

*using the same IP your views will only be counted once every 6-8 h -so we can't broke any record-

*bc you can't switch the IP address of your device the best  & only way is share the mv on SNS or your website so everytime the video will get played it will count as one view

🔔HOW TO STREAM ON YT WITH THIS METHOD:

1-go to youtube or youtube app

2-search for the mv you want to stream (EXO TEMPO MV)

3-start the mv

4-scroll down n click on SHARE and on EMBED

5-copy the whole text and go to facebook

6-paste the text & post it (make sure for the mv to actually show up)

7-now go to your facebook post and watch the mv as often as you can. Youtube can't track your IP anymore.

📱using this method on your phone,you can simply click on 'SHARE' and the app you want it to share with go to the app and stream 


🌟youtube needs some time to update views from external websites and apps, don't worry if the views won't rise with every click (had to wait for about 10-20 min).

text:
In this MV they're 6 members singing but at the time EXO were a 12 members group split in 2 sub unit of 6 members EXO-K and EXO-M (promoting respectively in Korea and China), however they're now 9 promoting fully as EXO, since 3 chinese members of EXO-M chosed to quit the group and become solo singers in their country.
Anyway here's the memebers.
EXO-K :
0:15 : Kai, main dancer and vocal
0:29 : Baekhyun main vocal
0:38 : D.O. vocal
1:11 : Suho : Leader of EXO, vocal
2:12 : Chanyeol : rapper
2:57 : Sehun : rapper, dancer, maknae

EXO-M (they just do an apparition here, if you want to see them correctly go look at the EXO-M version of history : https://youtu.be/i1xFTx8alMU)
2:29 : Lay main dancer, vocal, rap
2:32 : Kris (left the group) rapper, vocal, lezder of EXO-M
2:33 : Chen main vocal
2:34 : Luhan (left the group)
2:35 : Xiumin Vocal, rapper, dancer
2:36 : Tao (left the group) main rapper, dance, vocal

There is also another subunit you may see aroung called EXO-CBX , composed of Chen Baekhyun and Xiumin, that promote betwin 2 full EXO comebacks.

That's quite a lot of informations at once, but I hope I've helped you to figure things a bit better.
If you have any question feel free to ask o/

Btw the fandom is called EXO-L (yeah another sub unit to remember sorry haha 😂)

🚫١.لاتقم بتسجيل الدخول أثناء مشاهدتك للفيديو *(قم بذلك فقط أثناء وضع إعجاب للفيديو ثم قم بتسجيل خروجك و عُد لمشاهدة الفيديو مرة أخرى من دون تسجيل الدخول)* .

🚫٢.لاتقم بإيقاف الفيديو عند تشغيلك له ولا تقم بتقديمه أو إرجاعه أو تسريعه أو إعادة تشغيله.

✔٣.عند تسجيلك لدخول،إبحث عن عناوين فيديوهات إكسو لتكون من ضمن الأغاني الأكثر بحثاً عنها في اليوتيوب،ذلك طبعاً بعد حذف إسم الفيديو من مربع البحث والبحث عنه مجدداً.

✔٤.إمسح السجل مرة كل 15 دقيقة.

🚫٥.لاتقم بمشاهدة نفس الفيديو مراراً وتكراراً حتى لا يقوم اليوتيوب بإحتسابه كرسالة غير مرغوب فيها،لذلك شاهد أغاني أخرى لإكسو ذات مشاهدات أقل مثل:
>Exo - What Is Love
>Exo - Miracles In December
>Exo - Growl MV 2nd
>Exo - For Life
>Exo - Coming Over

وغيرها.

 🚫٦.لاتقم برفع المشاهدات من قائمة تشغيل فهي لن ترتفع حقاً‼

✔٧.بسبب بعض التحديثات في اليوتيوب،أصيبت بعض الحسابات بخلل ما،لذا عند ضغطك على إعجاب الموجود أسفل الفيديو فانه لن يتحسب مالم تكون العلامة زرقاء اللون،في هذه الحالة يفترض بك أن تقوم *-طبعاً ان أردت أن ترفع من نسبة اللايكات في أغاني إكسو-* بإضافة قائمة التشغيل هذه 👇 ومن ثَمَ قم بحذف كل المقاطع التي أعجبتك من *قائمة الفيديوهات التي أعجبتني* ثم قم بتشغيل هذه القائمة ومشاهدة كل فيديو والضغط على(👍)لكل فيديو.

text: Watching in 2017, I miss Exo I meant the Exo BEFORE. Not because of the members who left but simply because who they are right now is totally different from what I known them before. When I first saw them I fell in love and I felt the love and passion they have for music and their craft. I watched every guesting, stages, etc they had and it filled my heart up. Then just one day, it changed. I don't know why, I didn't stanned other groups to grew far from them but it just happened. Whenever I watch their guesting, performances, behind cams I feel like it's all ROBOTIC. I feel like the humans in them was sucked by something they can't get away from. Group change rather people change but then there's something missing about them, its like they are holding back from something they want to do but they are not allowed to do so.  I miss the old days, I'm sorry I failed to stay with you guys. I hope someday I'll find the answer why I stopped loving this group. You were amazing, if time machine do exist I would go back to that time where I first saw this MV over and over again. Wish you luck with your future endeavors!

My friend already saw them. But poor us, my friend didn't took any pictures nor videos cos they were crossing the street and the time was just limited. She cant stop by just to took any proof. She called me right after they cross the street where they saw the van. It was the first time she called. And it was already late in my country that time so I was already sleeping. Then she told me about what she saw. Its hard to believe right? But she assured me that it was them. And right after that day, theories and rumors came up. Rumor about the concept of their grand comeback. It said that their next comeback will hit and beat the growl era. What's on growl era then? The OT12. They will surely hit the growl era IF the three will going back to EXO. Well, maybe they will not going to plan that if they can't. MAYBE, since then (we'll never know) KrisHanTao already compromised with SM? What if, right? And then SM planned this comeback and said that they will beat the growl era which is EXO still at OT12? 🤔🤔 And their Planet #3 the Exo'rdium happened before their grand comeback. And as what I've said earlier, Exo'rdium in english is TO START. Is EXO will start again as OT12? And lets go back to MAMA era when Luhan and Kris left.
Like what if the whole thing Luhan and Kris leaving EXO is the whole concept? This thought got me when I saw the EXO teaser where two marbles were stuck inside the symbol while the ten were outside of it. Thw two were supposingly trapped inside while the other ten were free. In wolf Luhan and Kris seems to be known as the red forces because of their eyes. And that leads all the way back from MAMA. I know most people don't really memorize the narration part, so I decided to rewatch it. And when I did, The last sentence of it, really got to me. ' THE DAY THE RED FORCES PURIFY AND THE TWELVE FORCES REUNITE INTO ONE PERFECT ROOT. A NEW WORLD SHALL OPEN UP (is the last sentence refers to the Exo'rdium where in english is to begin or to start?) What if everything was planned to make the whole concept fit in together like a puzzle piece. A rubix cube that needs to be solved. Lets go to Love Me Right Mv.
Love Me Right MV where there is in one scene that all EXO members are on their lookers but when they left, 3 of their baseball uniforms are left hanging on their locker's door. Which is speculated that it was belong to the three who left the group. The two uniforms were hanging outside their locker's door, but the other one was hanging inside the opened locker. And my theory here was, the one who was inside the locker was belongs to Luhan. Luhan has the access to all the EXO members since then. So he will be the key to open the new beginning of the group. Which is in easy explanation is, he will be the one who can fix what's Kris and Tao's issue.
The Latin word Exo'rdium in english is to start, to begin or introduction. EXORDIUM AS OT12.

author: @lilymeryne
text:
Ok so I saw this mv (the first mv I saw of exo) like more than a year ago. First member that caught my eye was kai, reason is that kai looks like my childhood friend, he was younger than me and I was like his older sister and he was the nicest person you can meet. Kai just looks like an older version of him. Anyways that time I didn't know what a bias was or just choosing one member of a band, but I did like Kai as my man. Now my bias is suho, I would never have changed from Kai but I saw something....... From Kai..... That I just didn't like......that just made me ugh about him. Am I sad that I had to see that, yes but I'm fine.
Anyway I just wanted to say that I wish exo members were still this innocent, I look back at this vid, they were so cute. Now I'm slowly getting pulled away. 
It happens with a lot of bands or a certain member, vine likes to kill my sweet memories with nasty vids.
Happened with got7, jackson is my bias and jb was my bias wrecker. Then I saw that article +

author: @lilymeryne
text:
That said jb said something inappropriate to a fan (not about her) at a fan signing, the fan didn't like it, and then they asked jb about it on social network and he said that he is a grown man and he can say this stuff, and I slowly started deteriorating away from jb, I said to myself that it could not be true, that if I was that fan then I would have at least took a screenshot of that convo, that there was no evidence and so maybe it's just lies. I convince myself that. But I will probably not be able to look at jb the same way because there still is that slight chance that jb indeed said what he said. I hate finding things like that about members of bands I like. 

I guess what I'm trying to say is that if you're a fan and you see or hear something nasty about a band/member them plz don't put it out for the world to see, don't ruin everything for others, I don't want to know this nasty stuff. Thank you.

author: @Em-fz6eb
text:
I think one thing we can never do is make assumptions about idols. Their lives are specifically planned and tailored for the public; the way you speak makes it seem like you know them personally (if you do, please correct me)? The argument "but you can just /tell/" isn't valid because we don't know what they don't show us, which the majority of their lives. There was this English band a few years ago I really liked that seemed very close (they toured together for over five years), but they couldn't even remember each other's birthdays. My point is- I really don't think it's fair to make assumptions on interviews and tv shows. We don't actually know them at all.
But I should point out that it makes sense that Exo-M + Exo-K weren't very close during their debut days. They promoted in DIFFERENT COUNTRIES for close to two years. Only the past year or two have they actually promoted as one unit. Also, why is their bond so important to you? Bands create music; sure, some people might watch for the visuals, but at the end of the day, you come here to LISTEN TO MUSIC, don't you? I honestly don't care if a band all hates each other if the music they produce is nice to listen to.

author: @gloryuh
text:
EXO is divided in subgroups: EXO-K (sings in Korean, that's what the letter K stands for, and promotes in Korea) and EXO-M (sings in Mandarin, hence the letter M, and promotes in China)
But since the Wolf era they promoted as a whole, so they're called EXO. Just EXO.
EXO-L is the name of the fandom. The "L" stands for Love, and it also serves as aesthetic, it stands between K and M.

author: @gloryuh
text:
EXO-K has 6 members
EXO-M has 6 members
When they're together, they are called EXO, a band of 12 members.
But sadly, 3 members have left the group, so now EXO has only 9 members.

author: @VickyNoee
text:
Hola! ^.^ Yo no conocía casi el k-pop hasta el año pasado, que una amiga me empezó a hablar del k-pop y me hizo viciarme a SHINee, los brillositos *-* y desde ahí me empezó a gustar el k-pop  y a SHINee le tengo un cariño muy grande y los amodoro (mezcla de amo y adoro) xD  muuucho porque fue el primer grupo k-pop que me empezó a gustar :'D  y bueno, a lo que ibamos, que me enrrollo mucho y me pongo sentimentalista x) Tampoco soy fan de EXO desde hace mucho (llevo unos 5 meses o asi) pero ya los quiero tanto y es como si los conociera de siempre :')  Y sí, al principio cuesta un poco indentificar a cada uno (estamos hablando de 12 chicos... 12! xD ) pero poco a poco los vas conociendo mejor y cogiendo a cariño a cada uno de ellos. Para empezar EXO esta dividido en 2 subunidades EXO-K y EXO-M, EXO-K promueve el grupo en Corea y cantan en coreano, claro x) y EXO-M promueve el grupo en china y cantan en chino (? Bueno ya conoces a Kai, Baek, Luhan (es mi bias <3 ) y a Chan ahora te dejo los segundos en los que parecen los demás a los que aún no reconoces vale? ^.^
0:26 El que baila en el medio, ese es Sehun el maknae de EXO  y también rapero junto con Kai y Chanyeol en EXO-K  
0:38 Ese es D.O uno de los vocalistas principales junto con Baekhyun en EXO-K
1:11 Ese es Suho el líder de EXO-K 
 Ahora pasamos a EXO-M
2;30 Ese es Lay bailarín principal junto con Kai en EXO ^^
2:31 Ese es Kris, el líder de EXO-M  y también rapero de EXO-M
2:33 Ese es Chen vocalista principal junto con Luhan en EXO-M 
2:35 Ese es Xiumin también vocalista, rapero
2:36 y por último Tao maknae de EXO-M  y también rapero de EXO-M
Ah, dos de los miembros en EXO-M son coreanos, que son Xiumin y Chen y los demás son chinos ^^
Bué esa ha sido mi pequeña introducción de los miembros de EXO x) no se si me habré explicado bien o si me he equivocado en algo o.O xD pero espero que te haya servido de algo, ah, si quieres conocerles mejor yo te recomendaría que vieras EXO SHOWTIME, que es un reality de los chicos  ^^ ahí podrás conocer un poco mejor a cada uno de los miembros, y ver su día a día, lo que hacen, que les gusta hacer, cuando comen... etc. etc xD Te gustará, y te reirás mucho con esos 12 loquillos, los amarás, ya verás, luego no digas que no te avisé  XDDD Y bueno, aún no hay un fanclub oficial de EXO, pero la gran mayoría se hacen llamar EXOtics (aunque a mi no me convence mucho, la verdad) o EXO fan,  como prefieras :)
Espero que no te hayas cansado de leer mi testamento, y que te haya ayudado aunque sea un poquito!
Muchos besos, preciosa! :D
